text: Checkout API is returning 502 Bad Gateway for roughly 30% of POST /checkout requests in production since 14:05 UTC. Started right after deploy checkout-api v2.41.0. Card payments are failing for customers; retrying sometimes works.
hey the site feels really slow today, a few people in the office noticed. can someone look?

orders-api prod: every write is timing out. Logs full of `sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00`. Reads still work. Began around 09:40 this morning. DB host is orders-db-primary.eu-west-2.
In staging the search-indexer pod keeps getting OOMKilled (exit code 137) roughly every 10 minutes after we raised the batch size to 5000 yesterday. No customer impact, staging only.

Payments gateway alert: spike of HTTP 500 and 504 from /v1/charges, plus `StripeConnectionError` and internal code PAY-1042 in the logs. p99 latency went from 400ms to 9s. Region eu-west-1 only, us-east-1 looks normal. Prod.

Customers in Germany report they cannot log in since about 07:15 CET. They get 'Invalid session' after entering correct credentials. Support has 40+ tickets. We do not know which component is at fault yet.
